requirement: Futures position actions explicitly include add/remove margin; supersedes earlier scope review which did not define that entry.

scope.entry: Nonzero isolated linear position only; symbol and positionSide locked. Recovery entry remains available without an open position.
scope.verification: GET /fapi/v3/positionMargin/history: symbol,type,startTime,endTime,limit=500. Exact original clientTranId plus asset/side/symbol/type/amount/USER_ADJUST/time. Duplicate/conflicting same-ID rows rejected. Then signed full account-wide positionRisk and accountWithJoinMargin; target leverageBrackets refreshes limits.
scope.idempotency: Official clientTranId length <=64, duplicate same account/symbol rejected for 7days; client uses vm_ + 128 random bits. No automatic replay even after 7days.
scope.signer: Existing connected EOA or existing Privy wallet is user and signer; no replacement key/wallet; EIP712 Message chain1666 and shared microsecond nonces.

calculations.current_margin: positionRisk.isolatedWallet, cross-checked against the signed account position; not isolatedMargin or UPL
calculations.add_max: max(0,min(asset.availableBalance,asset.crossWalletBalance - sum(same margin asset isolated positionInitialMargin) - sum(same margin asset crossed maintMargin)))
calculations.remove_max: max(0,min(isolatedWallet - own signed account maintMargin,isolatedWallet + signedQuantity*(mark-entry) - mark*abs(quantity)/leverage))
calculations.precision: Decimal and exact Rational; recurring initial margin division rounds UP at32dp; Max floors to2dp. Client input policy <=8dp, not a claim of exchange precision for all assets; Aster validates final amount.
calculations.liquidation: Solve adjustedWallet + q*(P-entry) = abs(q)*P*MMR - cum in each bracket; compare candidate notional to floor/cap as Rational before24dp conversion. No valid nonnegative candidate => unknown. Display8dp estimate; actual liquidation reread separately.
calculations.ratio: Same signed account row maintMargin / (isolatedWallet + unrealizedProfit) *100; missing => unknown, nonpositive equity => explicit risk, no fabricated ratio.

integrity: 30second lifetime begins before first signed account read; preflight and final dispatch check original and new receipts, identity, revision and account/settings invalidation.
Default Add, empty amount; switching direction/cancel/error preserves input; clear original amount only after exact history verification.
Full context re-read before POST; quantity/entry/wallet/side/leverage/tiers must agree and current limit must still cover amount.

Separate position-margin-operations-v1.json loaded before runApp, flush and rename before dispatch; no signatures/credentials persisted. Corrupt/failed storage blocks writes. Shared order/settings/internal-transfer lease.
Once possibly sent, original public record persists across stop/logout/late response. Only exact original history verifies success; ACK and balance differences do not.
Explicit documented rejection codes -1021,-1022,-2014,-2015,-4049,-4050,-4051,-4054,-4055 are durably labeled rejected, not successful; refresh limits when possible. Other errors remain pending.
Actual position/account/tiers re-read after matching history. A later refresh failure is distinct from verified history and disables stale confirmation.
No auto reads/signing at page entry or startup; recovery is manual GET-only; no sent request cancellation implied by leaving.
New wallet operation enum excluded from subaccount menu and rejected by subaccount repository before network/signature.

Exact success with successful account/position reread closes the adjustment route; full signed snapshots update primary account and risk lists, invalidating older in-flight reads. Refresh errors keep a visible partial result. Explicit Cancel and close leave sent records recoverable.
remaining_boundaries: Real signer permissions, exact financial outcome, true server clock/nonce compatibility and native storage/lifecycle/layout acceptance not exercised.
History is bounded to500 returned rows; no documented pagination/result-by-ID endpoint. No match or truncated result stays pending, no balance inference/replay.
Local journal cap100 records, no silent eviction; archival UX not provided. Clear app data/uninstall cannot guarantee recovery.
User deferred device testing; no device tools or installation. Linux has no macOS/Xcode for iOS build.
Full cross-product Portfolio and Swap remain incomplete; BAPI stats/TWAP skipped per user.
